entry_state: Northstar now connects observed balances, identifiable aggregate movements, revisions and a joint conditional future, including receipt-aware recovery and unresolved inputs. A second parent/subsidiary example has supplied opening books and narrow tax assumptions; its transactions and consolidated close are still to be read.
exit_state: The parent/subsidiary close reconciles debt redemption,returns,internal margin,ownership and tax across successive periods. Loss recognition changes profit timing without changing the stipulated ultimate cash tax. The new bank/insurer group has defined its currency,taxpayer,deposit and calendar boundaries; its remaining profit and translation calculations are next.

findings.observation: Internal profit48 and deferred tax12 are derived before group profit27. The July ownership purchase changes equity,not profit; the later external sale releases the prior margin/tax. Separate shareholder roll-forwards and external cash give equity724 and cash644 without balancing plugs.

The fiscal continuation retains the historical reporting framework as a teaching premise. Recoverable loss quantity and enacted rate are distinct; the signed tax-expense decomposition explains the asset movement. Absence of recovery evidence remains unresolved rather than zero.

The next sector case states two year-end event dates,FCU/USD units and the same matched intercompany deposit before elimination. Its first loan recursion is visible, but the complete sector argument remains unread.
